newsitem.title: USA: Stocks fall in nervous market ahead of Greenspan talk.
newsitem.headline: Stocks fall in nervous market ahead of Greenspan talk.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks fell abruptly in a late sell-off Tuesday as Wall Street braced for the second leg of Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Congressional testimony Wednesday on the economy.
The Nasdaq market, however, rose on the strength of technology stocks.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 66.20 points, or 0.96 percent, at 6,852.72. But in the broader market, advancing issues led declines 13-11 on active volume of 539 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq Composite index was up 6.19 points at 1,317.37.
